title: NFL Draft Chime
blurb: Every NFL draft has one moment that matters, and this is its sound: the broadcast sting that means a pick is in and somebody's life is about to change on live television. Sports edits lean on it constantly, though the meme value runs a good deal broader, because it works for any selection at all. Choosing a restaurant. Picking teams at recess. Deciding who has to phone the landlord. The sound carries a bureaucratic finality, as though a decision has been formally lodged and can no longer be appealed. The pick is in.
origin: The 'pick is in' broadcast chime from NFL Draft coverage.
